body_markdown:
Bananas are having a moment, and we’re here for it, because bananas and[Lifeway Kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) are naturally made for each other. To show you what we mean, we’ve got five creative, delicious banana recipes to prove this duo’s appeal!


##


## Benefits of Bananas and Lifeway Kefir


Bananas bring natural creaminess, gentle sweetness, and[prebiotic fiber](https://lifewaykefir.com/prebiotics-probiotics/) that feeds beneficial gut bacteria. Lifeway Kefir counters this popular fruit’s benefits with a bright, effervescent tang and a powerhouse profile of[diverse live and active probiotic cultures.](https://lifewaykefir.com/probiotics) Lifeway Kefir is also a terrific source of complete protein that supports metabolic health, muscles, and overall wellbeing. See[9 Benefits of Lifeway Kefir here](https://lifewaykefir.com/benefits-of-lifeway-kefir/) .


## 5 Banana Recipes Made with Lifeway


Together, bananas and Lifeway Kefir form a synbiotic dream team to support your microbiome and help it thrive. Give them a spin in these five recipes to see how delicious and simple it is to turn wholesome foods into functional, nutrient-dense treats for everyday living. Then be sure to check out the bonus recipes below these for even more ideas!


### 1.[Banana Bread Latte](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/banana-bread-latte-smoothie/)


This probiotic Banana Bread Latte Smoothie made with Lifeway Kefir is our new favorite drink for a little boost. Bold coffee, sweet bananas, warm spices, and a whipped coffee foam on top make this a pleasurable comfort food drink from the first sip to the last. **[Recipe Here](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/banana-bread-latte-smoothie/)**


### 2.[Banana Cheesecake Pudding](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/banana-cheesecake-pudding/)


One of everyone’s favorite desserts is now easier than ever to make and enjoy with our Banana Cheesecake Pudding. Prepared with creamy, high-protein[Lifeway Farmer Cheese](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/cheese-farmer-cheese/) and[Lifeway Kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) , this dessert is filling without being heavy, just sweet enough, and enhanced with gut health benefits you’ll love. **[Recipe Here](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/banana-cheesecake-pudding/)**


### 3.[Chocolate Chip Banana Bread](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/chocolate-chip-banana-bread/)


There’s nothing like a warm slice of freshly baked banana bread, and when it’s adorned with a drizzle of chocolate and made with[Lifeway Kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) , every bite just gets better and better. Bake up a batch of this Chocolate Chip Banana Bread for a healthy, cozy snack that loves you back. **[Recipe Here](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/chocolate-chip-banana-bread/)**


### 4.[Probiotic Banana Split Smoothie](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/probiotic-banana-split-smoothie/)


Power up your next smoothie with a dessert-inspired twist featuring[Lifeway Muscle Mates Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/muscle-mates/) in this Probiotic Banana Split Smoothie, complete with a cherry on top! **[Recipe Here](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/probiotic-banana-split-smoothie/)**


###


### 5.[Banana Bread Cookies](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/banana-bread-cookies/)


We whipped our live kefir cultures into[Lifeway Kefir Butter](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewaykefirbutter) for you to enjoy even more ways to enjoy our kefir’s[probiotic benefits](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/probiotics) . In these Banana Bread Cookies, our salted kefir butter transforms bananas and chocolate chips into these delicious treats for a healthy snack made with better for you ingredients. **[Recipe Here](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/banana-bread-cookies/)**
